# n-dx documentation

> n-dx is a development toolkit that analyses an existing codebase, builds a
> product requirements document from it, and executes tasks against that PRD
> autonomously. It is built by En Dash Consulting and documented here.

The short version of how it fits together: **SourceVision** reads the
codebase and produces machine-readable context — a file inventory, an import
graph, zones found by community detection, a React component catalog.
**Rex** turns that context into a PRD tree and drives work against it. The
CLI and the MCP server are how you and your agent talk to both.

- Repository: https://github.com/en-dash-consulting/n-dx
- Marketing site: https://n-dx.dev
- These docs: https://docs.n-dx.dev

## Not current

- [Archive](https://docs.n-dx.dev/archive/) — point-in-time discovery and design
  records, kept because they explain *why* a decision was made. Every page
  there describes the project as it was on the day it was written and has not
  been maintained since. Model IDs, metrics, file counts and test results in
  those pages are frequently out of date. They are excluded from the sitemap
  for that reason, and should not be read as a description of how n-dx works
  today.
